Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Is there any interest for a Create-A-Clan tournament at Dragon*Con
this year? If so, I'll be happy to run one (non-sanctioned, of
course).

Create-A-Clan requires each player to invest some time up front
developing a set of vampires from scratch for a new clan of vampires
(replete with its own Hunting Ground), subject to some construction
restrictions regarding Discplines, repeated capacities, etc. Concept
courtesy of Ben Peal, who has had some success with the format before.

I'll adapt the rules a bit, but for a proof-of-concept, see the
tournament report (and links to the construction rules and resulting
clans that were developed) here:

http://www.darkwindrising.com/vampire/reports/2003/11.01.cac.asp

Anyone who will be attending D*C 2004 and would participate in such an
event, respond here or to my personal email, so that I can guage
interest levels.

Thanks.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
Links to V:TES news, rules, cards, utilities, and tournament calendar:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/

Reading through these rules and bemoaning the lack of more obscure
special abilities I was thinking maybe you could adjust the rules to
be something like:

A vampire may pay 1 point to get the basic ability of any minion card
in a discipline they have superior in (Ally, equipment and location
actions may not be used). If this card has a blood cost then the
special ability is "This vampire may burn [blood cost] once per turn
to ...". Specials such as intercept, stealth, bleed, strength bonues
that have no blood cost count as permanent active. Any other abilities
are only usable once per turn.
For half a point more a vampire may take the _Superior_ ability of a
card, usable only versus a specific sect.
For one point (and costing an extra blood per turn than it would
otherwise) a vampire could choose a disciplineless card. (Thereby
allowing built in Bum's Rushes or out of discipline maneouvres or
presses or things like that)

This would mean that someone with superior protean could take
"This vampire may burn one blood once per turn to gain +1 stealth" for
1 point
or
"This vampire may burn one blood once per turn to gain +2 stealth only
usable when a Sabbat vampire is attempting to block" for 1.5 points
or
"This vampire may burn one blood to make his handstrikes aggravated
for the remainder of the combat"

whereas someone with superior obfuscate could have a straight
+1 stealth for 1 point

To make checking the vampires at the start easier poeople should
include which card they are talking about. (Not printed on the vampire
of course)

This would keep abilities closely approximating the discipline
breakdowns (like they normally do now) and provides a costing
framework for a wide variety of different specials.
Given that some things are probably more unbalancing than others (and
reflecting your existing framework) you could add restrictions to
certain types of abilities or modify a few things like "only 9+ caps
may choose abilities that cost 2+ blood" and "only 6+ caps may choose
abilities that cost 1+ blood" or "all stealth abilities cost +.5" or
"all combat card based specials cost a minimum of 1 blood" (to avoid
infinite S:CE from built in majesty vamps).

The costing frameworks for normal cards exists so it shouldn't be too
hard to use it as a basis for costing specials since there are two
areas to use to balance things:
a) points vampires pay for ability
b) blood they pay to use it

Using either this system or something similar...

ThunderFoot.

I'll have you know that my last tournament deck used a crypt of

miniscule vampires in a create-a-clan format should not be believed
until after I play such a tournament, with said crypt, gaining 4-6 VP

That is an excellent lead-in to something I found missing from the
current CaC rules: point guidelines for 1-caps and 11+caps. If the
X-1 points rule applies to 1-caps, then a clan may only have one
1-cap, due to the discipline spread rule. So I'm looking at two
2-caps, two 3-caps, and a 1-cap. :)

Also, the rules may as well give all 11+caps a default("free") +1
bleed.
